context: Tests whether the SDK skill remains standalone for release work when the target repository has no local supply-chain policy.

checklist.name: keeps_sdk_release_in_scope
checklist.description: Handles SDK publishing and release safety within the SDK workflow instead of delegating to a sibling skill.

checklist.name: uses_trusted_refs_and_credentials
checklist.description: Requires a verified trusted ref, narrowly scoped credentials, and OIDC or trusted publishing when supported.

checklist.name: isolates_privileged_dependencies
checklist.description: Requires pinned actions, frozen fresh installs, and no pull-request cache reuse in privileged release jobs.

checklist.name: verifies_the_package
checklist.description: Runs canonical verification and inspects the packed or built artifact before credentials are loaded for publishing.

checklist.name: uses_a_durable_handoff
checklist.description: Publishes from the release tag and uses registry or release artifacts with provenance instead of temporary Actions artifacts as the durable boundary.
